finding: Chat renderer terminates URL tokens at pipes, while spam classification previously consumed pipes. Spoiler-wrapped credential links and pipe-separated link bursts could therefore evade the existing local signals.
change: Local URL extraction now terminates at pipes, preserving the existing credential, repetition and mention rules. Encoded pipes inside one URL remain intact. Decrypted content remains local.
